title: NHANES 1999-2002 pooled MEC weight scaling
locked_protocol_rule: Amendment 2.4 uses WTMEC4YR / 4 for 1999-2002 and WTMEC2YR / 8 for 2003-2014 in the pooled 1999-2014 NHANES estimand.
official_guidance: CDC instructs analysts combining 1999-2000 with 2001-2002 to use the provided four-year weight because the two cycles used different census reference populations.
recommended_resolution: For a 16-year 1999-2014 pooled analysis, use WTMEC4YR / 4 for 1999-2002 and WTMEC2YR / 8 for 2003-2014, then update the locked protocol, implementation, and tests together before marking resolved.
resolution: Resolved by protocol amendment 2.4 on 2026-07-14. The experiment configuration, locked runtime contract, harmonization code and tests must use the CDC-compatible source-specific pooled-weight rules.

title: NHIS congestive-heart-failure exclusion is unavailable in most primary years
locked_protocol_rule: Amendment 2.4 requires exclusion of baseline congestive heart failure together with coronary heart disease, angina, myocardial infarction, and stroke for the NHIS 1997-2014 fixed-horizon cohort.
official_guidance: IPUMS NHIS documents CONHFAILEV as available only in 1999 and 2002. In the delivered extract it is NIU in every other year, so treating NIU as absence would silently misclassify baseline disease and treating it as unknown removes all other years.
recommended_resolution: For the cross-year primary NHIS cohort, use the four consistently measured exclusions (coronary heart disease, angina, myocardial infarction, and stroke). Retain CONHFAILEV only for a documented 1999/2002 sensitivity audit. An alternative is the broader HEARTCONEV surrogate, but it is not equivalent to congestive heart failure and would require a new IPUMS extract and amendment.
resolution: Resolved by explicit user approval on 2026-07-14. The primary NHIS and NHANES cohorts use the same four consistently measured exclusions: coronary heart disease, angina, myocardial infarction, and stroke. CONHFAILEV remains unknown outside 1999/2002 and is used only for an NHIS 1999/2002 CHF-strict sensitivity subset; MCQ160B is retained for the parallel NHANES sensitivity.
